visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female character with reddish-brown hair, wearing a white school shirt, a pink cardigan with a red bow, and a dark blue pleated skirt, stands in a green-walled school hallway. She speaks with an energetic expression, gesturing with her hands while the camera remains static at eye level. (2) A male character in a black school uniform with round glasses joins her in the same hallway. They interact dynamically, leaning towards each other with exaggerated facial expressions. Background lighting is bright and indoor-focused, highlighting the textures of their clothing. (3) The scene transitions to a series of stylized frames with various backgrounds; first a decrepit, green-tinted corridor where the female character holds a phone and a flashlight, then a classroom setting where the male character flips through a book. (4) A dramatic shift occurs as a figure with long white hair and a floral dress appears in a dark, vaulted tunnel with high-contrast, low-key lighting. The male character reacts with extreme fear, fleeing from the camera. (5) In a clinical, lab-like setting with cold blue lighting, a figure with an enlarged, distorted head and wide eyes confronts the female character. She is shown falling or crouching on the floor, expressing distress. (6) A final montage follows, featuring rapid cuts of the characters posing against vibrant digital backgrounds with cosmic stars and colorful geometric shapes. The 'Flai' logo is frequently overlaid as a prominent green icon.

Intense, dark cinematic risers occur as the tone shifts to comedic horror. (4) Upbeat, high-tempo Electronic Pop BGM swells at approximately 128 BPM, featuring a strong percussive beat and bright synth leads. Female vocal narration continues with high articulation clarity. (5) Final phase features dense sound effects layering, including digital UI clicks, bubble pops, and anime-style combat impacts. The speech and music overlap continuously until the end.
